children: Weatherford filed a prospectus supplement to permit resale of 357,159 ordinary shares issued as merger consideration related to its NCS Multistage acquisition.
Prospectus supplement filed to Registration Statement No. 333-288045 to allow resale of up to 357,159 ordinary shares.
The shares were issued as merger consideration in connection with the closing of the acquisition of NCS Multistage Holdings.
Company filed a legal opinion as Exhibit 5.1 to this Form 8-K and incorporated it by reference into the Registration Statement.
